pages.text: $(italic)Lucky, efficient and oddly hard to hit. Halflings thrive in exploration and resource-gathering builds.$()$(br2)$(bold)Fortune's Favor$(): +8% luck stat, which affects loot table rolls, fishing and how well the Fortune enchant works.$(br2)$(bold)Food Efficiency$(): -20% food drain rate, the best food economy in the pack.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Small$(): -15% hitbox size bonus, so projectiles hit you less. Unlike vanilla, there is no movement penalty.$(br2)$(bold)Halfling Luck$(): once per death, a 10% chance to survive a killing blow at 1 HP. Cooldown: 20 min.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair with Wanderer or Artificer and go loot. Luck compounds on every chest.$()
